title: 7214: Fix Hexagon shape column span in block diagram
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Fix hexagon shape not respecting column spanning in block-beta diagrams.


Resolves #7214

comments.body: @ashishjain0512 ,`node.positioned` is only set by the block diagram, but it is consumed inside shared shape rendering functions like `rect` , `composite` , `hexagon`.

thread.actionability_reasoning: This is a pure question seeking clarification about the scope of `node.positioned` usage, with no implied suggestion or requested code change.
